paper.title: How Contaminated Is Your Benchmark? Measuring Dataset Leakage in Large Language Models with Kernel Divergence

summary: One invalid mathematical robustness inference (Major), two bounded specification/figure defects (Minor), and one unresolved membership-provenance item (Needs Evidence). Published empirical correlations are not numerically disproved.

findings.title: Bandwidth changes can reverse the score ordering
findings.source_claim: After Eq6, positive-power reweighting is argued not to influence relative trends across contamination rates.
findings.suspect_step: Entrywise monotonicity is transferred to differently weighted and normalized sums across datasets.
assumptions: All pre/post rows have unit norm
Same finite positive gamma before/after within each score
Ordinary RBF kernels with diagonals1 and positive eigenvalues
All distance changes in example positive
No assumption of realization by a particular trained LLM

check.type: analytic counterexample with independent symbolic and finite confirmation
check.expression: S_gamma(u,delta)=-2 gamma exp(-gamma u) delta/sqrt(2+2 exp(-gamma u))

counterevidence: Eq6 expansion itself is correct with common gamma.
Table3 empirical correlations may remain correct.
No actual contamination labels or LoRA trajectory assigned to synthetic configurations.
findings.impact: Invalid mathematical justification of a robustness property of the central ranking score; no inference that all empirical results fail.

correction.statement: Retain expansion; replace invariance inference with empirical robustness limited to tested configurations, or supply new sufficient conditions.
correction.verification: Logical scope correction supported; no empirical repair verified.

focused_acceptance.check: Parent checked the actual common-bandwidth score and p7 trend-invariance wording; rederived the two-point score, all four unit norms, distances and exact R_0.1>8/3 and R_1<10sqrt(2)/21 bounds. The reversal satisfies the functional assumptions and lies within tested bandwidths. The invalid entrywise-power-to-aggregate-ranking inference concerns the central scoring method; no trained-LLM realization or loss of empirical correlation is asserted. The empirical-only reading and scope correction remain explicit.

findings.title: Released defaults fit separate bandwidths
findings.source_claim: Common-gamma distance-change decomposition and unspecified median-heuristic fitting policy.
findings.suspect_step: Default code independently estimates gamma_pre and gamma_post; common-gamma interpretation omits bandwidth change.

check.type: static source plus independent exact formula and finite comparison
check.implemented_formula: -sum exp(-g u_ij)*abs(h v_ij-g u_ij)/sqrt(sum exp(-g u_ij))

counterevidence: Median heuristic description may intend separate fits with suppressed notation.
Fixed-gamma branch agrees with actual PDF including absolute values.
Adaptive statistic is not inherently invalid.
findings.impact: Method specification and release interpretation can change score ordering; actual published numerical impact unresolved.

correction.statement: Specify per-experiment bandwidth policy and generating code; use adaptive decomposition when applicable, or fit once and evaluate shared-bandwidth variant.
correction.verification: Formula correspondence and finite contrast verified; experiment rerun not performed.

focused_acceptance.disposition: supported; Minor unchanged; historical experimental effect unresolved
focused_acceptance.check: Parent statically checked separate median fits, default gamma=None, all four scripts and the fixed-gamma branch; rederived exp(-g*u)*abs(h*v-g*u), the positive medians and the unchanged-pair contribution. This confirms a specification/release discrepancy. The admissible separately-fitted-kernel reading and unproven linkage to the historical experiments prevent treating the release difference as demonstrated core experimental harm. Both formula branches remain distinguished and no author code was executed.

findings.title: Normalization plot conflicts with defined kernel sum
findings.source_claim: Figure6 labeled/captioned full kernel-entry sum; finite linear fit used to motivate sqrt(sum K) normalizer.
findings.suspect_step: Displayed values roughly55-165 at n350-700 violate diagonal lower bound for stated full sum.
assumptions: Defined full n-by-n sum includes diagonal
Graph interpreted according to visible label/caption

check.type: actual PDF visual plus analytic lower bound
check.additional_scope: For fixed IID distribution and fixed kernel E[T_n]=n+n(n-1)mu; not asserted unchanged for re-estimated bandwidth.
check.finite_diagnostic: Linear fit to n^2 at n=350,400,...,700 has exact R2=441/445>0.9766.

counterevidence: Possible undisclosed scaling, square root or diagonal removal.
Figure2 explicitly zeroes diagonal for visualization, Figure6 does not disclose it.
Paper promises mitigation, not exact size invariance.
findings.impact: Supporting normalization graph/rationale inconsistent as stated; score implementation errors not established.

correction.statement: Obtain plotting calculation; specify actual ordinate, scaling, diagonal handling and gamma, then replot/relabel and limit finite-fit inference.
correction.verification: Bound and finite illustration verified; exact plot repair unavailable without source calculation.

focused_acceptance.check: Parent actually inspected Figure6: x=350..700, displayed raw-sum values about55..165, no axis multiplier. Re-derived K_ii=1 and T_n>=n, the fixed-kernel IID expectation and the quadratic-fit diagnostic. The graph cannot be the defined full sum. Undisclosed scaling, square root or diagonal removal remains possible; Figure2 explicitly discloses its different diagonal convention. The defect concerns stated supporting evidence; no score implementation failure or exact-size-invariance promise is inferred.

findings.title: Pile split membership lacks target-model binding
findings.source_claim: Pile train/val mixtures validate actual contamination scoring without temporal confounding.
findings.suspect_step: Dataset split identity is treated as target-model pretraining membership without a documented link.
assumptions: M is actual membership in the selected model's pretraining set

check.type: logical dependency and static source inspection
check.result: Mixture fraction of L=1 matches membership fraction only under an additional documented L-M relation; IID splitting alone does not supply it.

counterevidence: IID splitting can reduce temporal cues.
Published correlations with assigned labels are not refuted.
Released commit is not proven to generate published tables.
findings.impact: Limits interpretation of principal response to temporal confounding; does not raise supported severity.

correction.statement: Supply model-specific training/held-out provenance or evaluate a model with known membership.

focused_acceptance.disposition: Needs Evidence unchanged; no mislabeling established
focused_acceptance.check: Parent checked the paper's train-as-seen/val-as-unseen interpretation and the static Mistral registry/split labels. Rechecked the logical distinction between dataset split L and target-model exposure M: IID splitting does not supply model-specific membership. Labels may nevertheless be correct, and the released commit is not established as the experiment-generating code. The missing provenance remains explicit and does not increase the supported severity.

limitations: No trained-LLM realization of synthetic configurations claimed.
No empirical reproduction, author code, installs or paid service.
Historical experiment-generating code and Pile memberships unresolved.
Erratum search bounded; no novelty claim for findings.

rejected_candidates.reason: Text extraction omitted bars; parent and code auxiliary inspected original PDF and confirmed Eq3-6 abs present. No removal-of-abs repair retained.
Original p15 explicitly contains absolute values.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Normalizer falsely promises exact size invariance
rejected_candidates.reason: Paper says mitigate size effects. Replication scaling is a scope clarification, not a separate defect.

remaining_work: Scientific provenance questions stated in P2-P4 remain unresolved
acceptance_state_note: Independent focused acceptance completed; original scientific assessments and exact report bytes retained. Scientific adjudication and repair adoption remain pending.
